sos.text: Lluwen, an elf who feels isolated among Arcavian elves, joins the Witherbloom trip to Titan's Grave, where he discovers a society of lumarets with a map, only for Professor Fel to dismiss them as not worth studying.

After slashing the taunting Ivarin with a knife and being told by Fel to control himself, Lluwen falls into the titan's hollow and sees six archaics gathered around a snarl of magic, but he is too afraid to tell Fel what he saw.
Lost deep in the grave, he leads his friends through the tunnels behind the lumarets and is seized by roots before Kirol promises not to leave him behind, and he finally tells Fel about the snarl.
When Tam steps into the pit and the nexus snaps shut, Lluwen speaks to the archaic and the lumarets mirror his movements, and gold light settles reality.
